title: OSCAL Vault CUI Classification + Provenance Sidecar
description: Generic schema for a per-system CUI classification and source-document provenance record. See docs/ADR/ADR-024-cui-provenance-datacontract.md. This schema describes the *shape* of a classification record; it does not itself classify any system. A sidecar with cui_category: not_cui is a valid, complete record (a reviewed 'not CUI' determination is a first-class state, not an absence of data).

system_slug.description: Must match the vault directory name under examples/vault/.

cui_category.description: A NARA CUI Registry category code (e.g. ISVI, SP-PRIV) or the literal 'not_cui'.

cui_marking.description: Banner marking string (e.g. 'CUI//ISVI'), or 'not_cui' when uncategorized.

authority.description: Citing statute, regulation, or policy memo backing the classification decision.

approved_by_role.description: Role of the approver (e.g. 'ISSO', 'data-owner'). A 'TBD-*' prefix is valid and means approval is pending.

approval_ref.description: Pointer to the approval record (ticket, email thread, ATO memo). May explicitly state that no approval is yet recorded.

source_doc_ref.description: Pointer to the source document (never the file itself; see ADR-009).

sha256.description: Content hash of the source document. All-zero is a valid placeholder until the real hash is recorded.

downstream_artifacts.description: Repo-relative paths of generated artifacts this classification governs.
